title: Software Engineer
description:
SW ENGINEER LINUX, KERNEL & SMARTNIC Build the software stack behind next-generation high-speed networks. Location: Gurgaon & Hyderabad, India
 Experience: 5-20 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Function: R&D Embedded Systems & High-Performance Networking About Qbit Labs Qbit Labs is building the networking and compute fabric for intelligent machines. We are an Embedded Systems and FPGA-Based Product Company developing mission-critical technologies for Defense, Aerospace, AI Infrastructure, High-Speed Networking, Secure Communications and Next-Generation Computing . Our engineering spans the complete stack — from FPGA and hardware acceleration to Linux, kernel, networking and application software . We are looking for a Software Engineer – Linux, Kernel & SmartNIC to join our growing R&D team and work on next-generation SmartNIC, high-speed Ethernet, deterministic networking and low-latency computing platforms . This is an opportunity to work on systems where every microsecond, every packet and every bit matters. THE ROLE You will design, develop and optimize Linux-based software and high-performance networking stacks for FPGA-accelerated and SmartNIC platforms. You will work at the intersection of: Linux + Kernel + Embedded Software + Ethernet + FPGA + SmartNIC + PCIe + Low-Latency Networking You will collaborate closely with FPGA/RTL, hardware and system engineers to build complete hardware-software solutions. WHAT YOU WILL BUILD Linux-based software for SmartNIC and FPGA-accelerated networking platforms High-performance Ethernet and packet-processing software Linux Kernel modules and device drivers PCIe and DMA-based host-to-FPGA communication Low-latency and deterministic networking solutions Software interfaces for FPGA-based networking and acceleration IP Data-plane acceleration and hardware-offload frameworks Embedded Linux software for mission-critical systems Networking and synchronization solutions for telecom and high-speed infrastructure KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Linux & Kernel Develop and optimize Linux Kernel modules, drivers and low-level system software . Work with Linux internals including memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization and networking subsystems . Debug complex kernel and hardware/software integration issues. Develop BSP-level and embedded Linux software where required. High-Performance Networking Develop software for high-speed Ethernet and packet-processing systems . title: Software QA Engineer - IoT and Device-to-Cloud
description:
Neu Edge is looking for a hands-on Software QA Engineer with proven experience testing connected devices communicating with cloud/backend platforms over IP networks . 
 This is not a conventional web-application QA role . The candidate must have worked on products where a physical device, embedded system, gateway, router, access point, IoT device or similar equipment communicates with backend/cloud services. You should be comfortable testing and troubleshooting the complete chain: Physical Device TCP/IP Network Communication Protocol/API Cloud/Backend Database/Services Application/Dashboard You must also have hands-on experience building test automation using Python . 
 Mandatory experience Candidates should apply only if they have practical commercial experience in all of the following: Python test automation: personally written and maintained automated tests using Python, preferably PyTest, Robot Framework or similar. TCP/IP networking: hands-on testing and troubleshooting of TCP/IP communication, including IP addressing, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, ports, sockets, HTTP/HTTPS and network connectivity. Connected-device testing: testing physical IoT, embedded, edge, gateway, router, access-point or similar connected devices. Device-to-cloud testing: tested data or commands travelling between a physical device and a cloud/backend platform. Cloud/backend testing: validated backend services, REST APIs, message brokers, cloud services, databases or microservices associated with connected devices. Linux: comfortable using Linux command-line tools and analysing device/application logs. Network troubleshooting: hands-on use of tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, ping, traceroute, iPerf, curl, netstat/ss or similar. API testing: experience validating REST APIs, authentication, payloads, responses and backend behaviour. End-to-end system testing: ability to independently isolate whether a problem originates in the device, network, protocol, backend, database or UI. 
 What you will work on You will design and execute automated and manual tests for connected-device platforms. The role will involve validating device connectivity, provisioning, authentication, telemetry, configuration, command-and-control flows and recovery behaviour. You will test scenarios including network interruption, latency, packet loss, reconnection, duplicate messages, delayed messages, device reboot and backend service failure. You will develop Python automation covering devices, APIs, backend services and end-to-end workflows. You will analyse device logs, network traces, backend logs and API responses to identify root causes. You will work with developers, network engineers, DevOps engineers and product teams to reproduce defects, validate fixes and improve release quality. 
 Technical environment Relevant experience with some of the following would be particularly useful: Python, PyTest, Robot Framework, Linux, TCP/IP, TCP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi/WLAN, Ethernet, MQTT, WebSockets, REST APIs, SSH, Wireshark, tcpdump, iPerf, Postman, Git, Docker, Jenkins/GitLab/Azure DevOps, AWS/Azure/GCP or private-cloud platforms. 
 MQTT experience would be especially useful because it is a strong indicator that the candidate has actually worked with connected-device architectures. 
 This role is unlikely to be suitable if your experience is primarily in: Selenium/web UI automation without connected-device experience; manual testing only; automotive CAN/UDS/HIL testing without IP/cloud connectivity; telecom OSS/BSS application testing without device/network testing; network administration without software QA; API testing without physical-device integration; or embedded/firmware testing where the product does not communicate with a backend/cloud platform.

Key Skills: Device Testing,Python Testing,Mqtt,Linux,IoT Testing,device to cloud testing,WiFi Testing,TCP/IP Testing

title: Quality Management System Manager
description:
Job Description: QMS Manager

Company: Sharpwire
Position: Quality Management System (QMS) Manager
Experience: Minimum 5 years
Industry: Automotive / Manufacturing

Position Summary

Sharpwire is looking for an experienced QMS Manager to lead and strengthen our Quality Management System, ensure compliance with ISO 9001 & IATF 16949 requirements, and drive continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality processes.

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience, with strong exposure to internal audits, customer audits, certification audits, corrective actions, defect reduction, and quality performance monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

QMS & IATF 16949

   Lead and maintain the companys IATF 16949 Quality Management System.
   Keep ISO documents updated and ensure ISO compliance.
¢   Ensure compliance with applicable customer-specific requirements and quality standards.
¢   Plan and conduct internal QMS and process audits.
¢   Lead preparation for IATF, customer, and certification-body audits.
¢   Ensure timely closure and effectiveness verification of audit findings and non-conformities.
¢   Maintain QMS documentation, procedures, work instructions, records, and quality objectives.

Defect Reduction & Quality Improvement

¢   Drive initiatives to reduce internal and external defects, rejection, rework, scrap, and customer complaints.
¢   Monitor quality KPIs and identify areas requiring immediate corrective or preventive action.
¢   Lead Root Cause Analysis, 8D, CAPA, 5-Why, Fishbone, and other problem-solving activities.
¢   Establish and monitor defect-reduction targets for production and supporting functions.
¢   Work closely with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Supply Chain teams to eliminate recurring quality issues.

Quality Trend Analysis

¢   Track quality defects and trends by product, process, machine, shift, customer, supplier, and defect type.
¢   Develop and maintain Pareto analysis, trend charts, rejection reports, and quality dashboards.
¢   Identify recurring and emerging quality trends and initiate preventive actions before issues become major problems.
¢   Present quality performance, trends, risks, and improvement actions to management.
¢   Use data-driven analysis to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and defect prevention.

Customer Quality

¢   Monitor and manage customer complaints and quality concerns.
¢   Ensure effective and timely response to customer complaints, including 8D reports and corrective actions.
¢   Track customer PPM, complaints, returns, and other customer quality indicators.
¢   Work with relevant teams to prevent recurrence of customer issues.

Continuous Improvement

¢   Drive PDCA and continual improvement activities throughout the organization.
¢   Establish quality improvement projects focused on defect reduction, process capability, and customer satisfaction.
¢   Promote a strong zero-defect and prevention-oriented quality culture.
¢   Monitor the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

¢   Lead and develop the Quality team.
¢   Train employees on QMS requirements, quality procedures, problem-solving, and audit readiness.
¢   Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues.
¢   Ensure accountability for quality objectives and improvement actions across departments.

Required Qualifications & Experience

¢   Bachelors degree/Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, Quality, or related field.
¢   Minimum 5 years of hands-on IATF 16949 audit experience.
¢   Strong experience in IATF 16949 QMS implementation, maintenance, and auditing.
¢   Experience handling IATF certification audits, customer audits, and internal audits.
¢   Strong knowledge of:
 * IATF 16949
 * ISO 9001
 * Core Tools APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC
 * 8D / CAPA / Root Cause Analysis
 * Process and Product Auditing
 * Control Plans
 * Statistical and trend analysis
¢   Proven track record of reducing defects, rejection, scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
¢   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
¢   Good communication and leadership skills.
¢   Proficiency in Excel and quality data analysis/reporting.

Preferred

¢   Automotive manufacturing experience.
¢   Experience with wire, cable, harness, metal forming, stamping, or related manufacturing processes.
¢   Certified IATF 16949 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor.
¢   Experience with customer-specific requirements and major automotive customer audits.
¢   Experience implementing measurable quality improvement projects.


Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the ability to maintain a robust IATF 16949 QMS, achieve strong audit performance, identify quality trends early, eliminate recurring defects, reduce overall rejection and customer complaints, and establish a culture of prevention and continuous improvement at Sharpwire.

 We are seeking a hands-on Enterprise Power BI Architect to define, design, and govern the BI architecture across programs and client accounts. This role focuses on building scalable, secure, and high-performance reporting solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. 
 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and delivery leads to translate business needs into enterprise reporting frameworks. The role requires a strong combination of Power BI technical expertise, architectural thinking, governance, and stakeholder engagement. 
 This is an individual contributor role focused on architecture and delivery oversight, rather than people management.   
 Your future duties and responsibilities: 
 Architecture & Solution Design 
 Design, develop, and oversee Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports aligned with business requirements.

 Architect scalable semantic models, reusable data models, and enterprise reporting frameworks.

 Define and enforce data security strategies, including Row-Level Security (RLS), access governance, and workspace security. 
 Drive performance optimization across datasets, data models, reports, and enterprise workspaces.

 Governance & Strategy 
 Define and enforce BI governance standards including naming conventions, workspace strategy, and deployment pipelines.

 Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend modernization and architecture improvements. 
 Ensure data governance, compliance, and security standards are maintained. 
 Act as a steward for analytics platform maturity and standardization across accounts. 
 Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership 
 Lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, program leaders, and clients. 
 Translate business strategy and analytical needs into actionable reporting and architecture roadmaps. 
 Clearly articulate trade-offs, risks, scalability considerations, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Provide solution architecture support for presales, estimations, and strategic initiatives. 
 Delivery Enablement & Team Leadership 
 Guide BI developers and tech leads on data modeling, DAX optimization, and Power BI best practices. 
 Conduct architecture reviews, design validations, and solution quality assessments. 
 Enable DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and monitoring practices for Power BI solutions. 
 Mentor teams and promote enterprise BI delivery maturity and technical excellence.   
 Required qualifications to be successful in this role: 
 Must-Have Skills

 Strong stakeholder communication and architectural leadership capabilities.

 Job location :- Any out of 6 AI locations

 About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

 WHATS IN IT FOR YOU 

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

 What you would do in this role 

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP) 
 Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability. Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics. Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager. Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms. Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference. Collaborate Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering. Ensure Governance Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically. 

 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP) 
 Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc. Provide deep domain expertise in our clients business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc. Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer Assess and audit the current state of a clients marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect. Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client. Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation. Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the clients needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools. Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations. Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing Perform technical analysis design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard. 

 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI) 
 Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP. Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities. Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making. Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents. Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources. Leverage Gemini models'' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts. Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents. Implement and leverage grounding evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications. Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini. Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components. Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access. Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems. Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques. Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations. Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment. Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders. Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities. 

 Other roles and responsibilities 
 Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations. Project management expertise for sprint planning Provide hands-on support and platform training for our clients. Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc. Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives - delivery dates, quality objectives etc.

You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.

 Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP. Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities. Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making. Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents. Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources. title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 1. Test Planning and Quality Assurance Own the end-to-end QA process for the Myfuel application. Develop test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases. Review business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria. Identify functional gaps, edge cases, integration risks, and potential business-impacting defects. Ensure appropriate test coverage across new features, enhancements, and existing functionality. Establish and maintain QA standards, processes, and best practices. Participate in release planning and provide quality assessments before deployment. 2. Hands-on Functional and Manual Testing Perform hands-on functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing. Validate workflows related to fuel procurement, delivery, transfers, and operational tracking. Test user roles, permissions, workflows, notifications, invoices, delivery tickets, and reports. Verify calculations involving fuel quantities, pricing, costs, revenue, and profitability. Identify data inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect calculations, and workflow failures. Conduct negative testing and boundary-value testing to identify potential production issues. Validate responsive behavior and compatibility across supported browsers and devices, where applicable. 3. Test Automation Evaluate, develop, and maintain automated test cases based on project requirements and priorities. Identify repetitive, high-risk, and regression-prone scenarios suitable for automation. Contribute to the development of a scalable and maintainable automation framework. Integrate automated tests into the development and release process where applicable. Analyze automation failures and distinguish between application defects, test issues, and environment-related failures. Ensure automated test scripts remain reliable, maintainable, and aligned with product changes. Automation framework and tool selection will be based on the project's technical requirements and the candidate's relevant experience. 4. API and Backend Testing Perform API testing for application services and backend integrations. Validate request and response structures, status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling. Verify data consistency between frontend applications, APIs, and databases. Test positive, negative, boundary, and failure scenarios for APIs. Investigate integration issues across different services and application components. Use appropriate API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent solutions. 5. Database and Data Validation Write and execute SQL queries for data verification and testing. Validate data integrity across relevant database tables and application workflows. Verify record creation, updates, deletions, relationships, and transaction consistency. Identify data duplication, missing records, incorrect mappings, and calculation discrepancies. Support backend troubleshooting by collaborating with developers and technical teams. 6. Hardware and System Integration Testing Support testing of integrations between the Myfuel application and associated hardware devices. Validate data received from hardware devices and its representation within the application. Test connectivity, data transmission, device-related workflows, and failure scenarios. Assist in identifying issues involving hardware, network connectivity, APIs, and application processing. Collaborate with developers and hardware teams to reproduce and troubleshoot integration defects. 7. Performance, Reliability, and Security Awareness Identify performance risks in critical application workflows. Support load, stress, and reliability testing where required. Test application behavior under high data volumes and concurrent user activity. Identify common security-related issues involving authentication, authorization, access control, and sensitive data. Work with the development team to investigate performance bottlenecks and system reliability issues. 8. Defect Management and Reporting Log, track, prioritize, and manage defects throughout the testing lifecycle. Provide clear and detailed defect reports with reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence. Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve issues. Perform defect retesting and regression testing after fixes. Monitor defect trends, recurring issues, and release-related risks. Prepare QA status reports, test execution reports, and release-readiness updates for stakeholders. 9. Team Leadership and Mentoring Lead and coordinate the QA team's daily testing activities. Allocate testing tasks based on team members' skills, workload, and release priorities. Review test cases, test scenarios, and testing deliverables prepared by team members. Mentor QA engineers in testing methodologies, debugging, automation, and quality practices. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage continuous improvement. Monitor testing progress and communicate risks, dependencies, and blockers. Support recruitment, onboarding, and technical evaluation of QA team members when required. Promote accountability, collaboration, and consistent testing standards across the team. 10. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, project managers, and other stakeholders. Participate in sprint planning, refinement meetings, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Clarify requirements and identify ambiguities before development and testing. Provide timely feedback on product quality, usability, and potential business risks. Support production issue investigation and root-cause analysis. Contribute to improving the overall software development and release process. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Technical Skills 812 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance. Strong experience in manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing. Experience in designing comprehensive test strategies, scenarios, and test cases. Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent. Strong SQL and database testing skills. Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira or equivalent. Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software testing life cycle (STLC). Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Practical exposure to test automation and automation framework development. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Understanding of CI/CD workflows and their application to testing. Automation and Programming Experience with at least one automation framework, such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or an equivalent tool. Programming experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, or another relevant language. Ability to create reusable, maintainable, and scalable automation scripts. Experience identifying suitable test cases for automation. Understanding of automation execution, reporting, and troubleshooting. Preferred Skills Experience testing logistics, transportation, fuel management, ERP, or other operational platforms. Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, Locust, or equivalent. Experience testing hardware-software integrations or IoT-based applications. Familiarity with Docker, cloud environments, or CI/CD tools. Experience with mobile application testing, if applicable. Knowledge of application security testing fundamentals. Experience working with systems that handle high transaction volumes and large datasets. Leadership and Behavioral Competencies Strong ownership of product quality and testing outcomes. Ability to work hands-on while managing and mentoring a QA team. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify hidden defects. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Effective task prioritization and time management. Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams. Proactive approach to identifying risks and improving QA processes. Willingness to learn the product domain and understand business-critical workflows.

title: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device
description:
Job Description: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device (LTE/5G/ Wi-Fi) 
 Role Overview 
 The QA Engineer – Wireless RAN & Device Validation is responsible for end-to-end validation of LTE and 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions, ensuring feature compliance, RF performance, interoperability, and customer experience across commercial network deployments. The role involves validation of eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN platforms, radio features, RF performance, and protocol compliance, while also supporting validation of LTE/5G devices including smartphones and FWA CPEs to ensure seamless end-to-end interoperability between network and devices. The engineer will work closely with RAN & Device Engineering, Product, Network Operations, OEMs, and chipset vendors throughout the product lifecycle. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Define test strategy, test plans, test cases, and RTM for LTE/5G/WiFi RAN products and wireless solutions. Perform end-to-end validation of LTE/LTE-A/5G NR features, covering functional, protocol, RF, interoperability, performance, regression, and customer experience testing Validate Macro Cells, Small Cells, vRAN/ORAN, and eNB/gNB deployments in both lab and field environments Execute RF validation for TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, Beamforming, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and Throughput Conduct acceptance testing, benchmarking, and standards compliance validation against 3GPP and O-RAN specifications Analyze Layer 1–3 logs and troubleshoot air interface, S1/X2/Xn, IMS, and interoperability issues through Root Cause Analysis Develop and maintain OTA and conducted test lines in Lab for end-to-end RAN, Core, and Device validation Validate LTE/5G commercial devices (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, and data devices) to ensure network interoperability and customer experience Collaborate with RAN strategy/ planning, Device Engineering, Network teams, OEMs, and chipset vendors for issue resolution and product quality improvements Drive test automation, manage the defect lifecycle, prepare technical documentation, and provide Go/No-Go recommendations for commercial releases. 
 Required Skills & Technical Expertise 
 Strong knowledge of LTE/LTE-A, 5G NR (NSA/SA),Wi-Fi(802.11ac/ax/be), vRAN, ORAN, IMS, RAN architecture, and 3GPP/O-RAN standards Good understanding of RF technologies including TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, Carrier Aggregation, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and throughput optimization Hands-on experience in RAN feature, protocol, performance, KPI, capacity, stability, and interoperability testing Proficiency in RF and wireless test tools such as TM500, Keysight, Anritsu, QXDM, TEMS, XCAL, Wireshark, iPerf, and IxLoad Strong expertise in Layer 1–3 log analysis, protocol debugging (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS), and end-to-end call flow analysis Exposure to LTE/5G device validation (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, MiFi) with ADB and chipset debugging tools (Qualcomm/MediaTek/UNISOC) is an added advantage Knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages for test automation is desirable Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 8–12 years of experience in LTE/5G RAN Testing, RF Validation, or Telecom Product QA. Hands-on experience in eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN, RAN feature validation, RF performance, protocol analysis, and interoperability testing. Experience in commercial acceptance testing and field validation of LTE/5G radio products. Exposure to LTE/5G device validation and end-to-end network-device integration will be an added advantage. Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related Engineering discipline.

description:

The role will focus on ensuring that AI agents reliably retain, retrieve, and manage contextual information across both individual conversations and multiple sessions. You will test stateful and personalized agent behaviors , memory extraction and retrieval, lifecycle controls, and regression scenarios to ensure that memory improves agent performance without introducing incorrect or irrelevant context. What project we have for you About the Client Our client is a large global enterprise operating across multiple markets, with a complex technology landscape and a strong focus on digital transformation and innovation. The organization is actively investing in modern cloud, data, and AI capabilities to enable scalable, secure, and highly automated solutions across its business. About the Project The project is focused on building an enterprise-grade AI Agent Platform from the ground up. The platform will provide a standardized foundation for developing, deploying, orchestrating, securing, and observing AI agents across multiple teams and use cases. The initiative covers the full agent lifecycle and brings together agent orchestration, observability, security, governance, integrations, evaluation, and platform engineering. Engineers joining the project will have an opportunity to influence key architectural and technical decisions and contribute to a new platform rather than maintaining an existing solution. What you will do Design and execute functional tests for short-term and long-term agent memory . Validate in-session context continuity and cross-session memory recall . Test memory extraction strategies to ensure that summaries, facts, and preferences are captured correctly . Validate memory retrieval to ensure agents retrieve relevant context while filtering irrelevant information . Test memory isolation to prevent inappropriate context sharing between users, sessions, or agents. Validate user deletion and privacy-related memory workflows . title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Automation Test Engineer to design, develop, and maintain reliable automated test solutions that improve product quality, testing coverage, release speed, and overall confidence in software releases. The role involves building scalable automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into the development and deployment lifecycle. The candidate will be responsible for developing automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests to validate application functionality across different environments. You will design reusable automation frameworks, test utilities, and supporting components that make test execution efficient, maintainable, and reliable. Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript are required, along with hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium . The role also involves integrating automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines using tools and platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar solutions. You will investigate failed test executions, analyze test results, and distinguish genuine application defects from test failures caused by automation instability, environment issues, or unreliable test data. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining test data, test environments, automation scripts, execution reports, and test documentation . You will work closely with developers and QA teams to improve application testability, identify quality risks, and ensure that automated tests provide meaningful coverage throughout the development lifecycle. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and a good understanding of software testing principles, automation patterns, Git, CI/CD, SQL, Docker, and test framework design . Familiarity with performance testing, security testing, and modern testing practices is an added advantage. You will contribute to continuous improvement of the automation framework and testing process by identifying opportunities to increase coverage, reduce execution time, improve test stability, and support faster and more reliable software releases.

title: Sr Technical Support Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. The Role Customer Support and Training teams are responsible for resolving customer issues, ensuring any customer experience is delivered to high quality standards and training, and working amongst cross-functional teams for the best solutions. Our goal is to continuously provide product improvements, business growth, with the highest level of customer satisfaction.
This role is for the DGM business unit within AspenTech, which focuses on software for the power and utilities industry. Your Impact Provide loyalty-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage. Troubleshoot & resolve complex technical and/or engineering related problems reported by customers using AspenTech s proprietary software. Responsible for the escalation of customer issues and driving the resolution cross-functionally within AspenTech. Deliver high-quality training classes, based on the relevant principles of engineering and industrial processes, to AspenTech customers. Develop and/or maintain customer focused training materials for new releases and new applications in the industry. Develop strong relationships with customers, building an understanding of their business needs and challenges. Collaboration with other AspenTech functions to maintain and develop business opportunities. Function as a subject matter expert in AspenTech s pre-release software testing program to drive improved product quality. Other tasks may include: Conduct health checks on assigned accounts; deliver onsite support and consultancy; deploy AspenTech solutions in customer business environments; execute various departmental improvement projects as needed; author technical white papers for publication to AspenTech s web knowledgebase. What Youll Need 4+ year(s) Relevant/industry experience preferred. University experience may count. Exposure to SCADA/control systems. Previous experience with AspenTech software or other advanced tool from another vendor is a plus. Knowledge of SCADA protocols such as ICCP, IEC 60870-5-104 (IEC104), and DNP3. Knowledge of SQL databases including Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, general DBMS concepts, and Cassandra concepts. Strong understanding of networking concepts, TLS 1.3, HTTPS, Windows OS, Red Hat Linux OS, firewall troubleshooting, as well as routing and switching. Knowledge of cybersecurity practices including vulnerability assessment, mitigation, and patch management. Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills. The ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset. Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities. Ability to travel. Travel is usually less than 25% and may occasionally be international. Bachelor s Degree required in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering or related field. Masters degree preferred. Strong technical background in automation and computers preferred. Knowledge of public utilities is a plus. #LI-RR1

Strong hands-on experience in SAP US Payroll implementations, combined with a solid understanding of US payroll business processes, tax regulations, year-end activities, and payroll technology. The consultant will work closely with US clients, understand their payroll requirements, provide functional and technical guidance, and contribute to SAP Payroll RFP/RFI and new business activities. Key Responsibilities SAP US Payroll Functional & Techno-Functional Lead and support SAP US Payroll implementations, enhancements, and client-facing payroll engagements. Understand and analyze US payroll business processes and translate business requirements into appropriate SAP Payroll solutions. Support payroll troubleshooting, issue analysis, root-cause identification, and resolution. Work closely with technical teams where development, integrations, interfaces, or system enhancements are required. US Payroll Process & Compliance Experience of working with US Payroll processes is mandatory (minimum 5+ years). Client-Facing Responsibilities Act as a key SAP US Payroll point of contact for US-based clients. Conduct requirement discussions, workshops, solution discussions, and issue-resolution meetings. Clearly communicate complex payroll and SAP concepts to business and technical stakeholders. Manage client expectations and provide timely updates on issues, solutions, and deliverables. Work effectively with US clients and global delivery teams. Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work independently during US business hours. SAP Payroll RFP / RFI & Business Development Support Support SAP Payroll RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and new business opportunities. Knowledge of 401(k), insurance, benefits, deductions, and related payroll processes. Strong techno-functional understanding of SAP Payroll. Ability to connect business payroll requirements with SAP technology/solutions. Excellent communication and client-facing skills. Experience working directly with US clients/stakeholders. Ability to contribute to SAP Payroll RFP/RFI and pre-sales activities. Preferred Skills Experience with SAP Payroll integrations and interfaces. Exercises self-discipline and work ethics Respect and follow company policies and procedures

Experience in preparation of general arrangement drawings for various process units in 2D and 3D. General layouts, Hydraulic flow diagram, Piping layout, PID is required. Good knowledge of pipe standards and Indian/International codes. Good knowledge of pipes, valves/sluice gates, fittings, pumps, blowers, mechanical screens, scraper mechanisms, diffusers and other electromechanical equipment related to WWWT. title: Engineering Manager QA (Manual)
description:
Job Overview We are looking for a QA Engineering Manager to lead the Software QA organization at Inito and own quality engineering across our software products and platforms. The role will be responsible for QA planning, resource allocation, hiring, team development, test strategy, release readiness, and execution tracking across Android, iOS, Backend, APIs, Databases, Web Applications, internal tools, growth tools, and firmware/device integrations . This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong understanding of software testing, team management, planning, execution, and quality processes. The person will work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, Developers, Firmware teams, and Software Leadership to ensure that multiple parallel projects are adequately staffed, properly tested, and delivered with the required quality. 
 Reporting to: Director of Software / Senior Engineering Manager (Software) Function: Software (QA) 
 Roles and Responsibilities Own the overall Software QA function across Android, iOS, Backend, APIs, Databases, Web Applications, internal tools, growth tools, and firmware/device integrations . Own QA resource and capacity planning across all active projects based on project priorities, testing effort, timelines, skill requirements, and available bandwidth. Own QA hiring planning , new hiring, replacements/backfills, interview processes, onboarding, and overall team capacity planning. Build and maintain yearly, quarterly, monthly, and bi-weekly QA plans in discussion with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Firmware, and other relevant teams. Track daily testing progress across projects, including execution status, blockers, dependencies, defects, environment issues, and release risks. Ensure adequate test planning and coverage for functional, integration, regression, API, database, compatibility, device, and end-to-end testing. Drive release readiness by ensuring testing completion, defect status, regression results, unresolved risks, and dependencies are clearly understood before release. Define clear KRAs for QA Leads, Senior QA Engineers, and QA Engineers and conduct regular monthly performance reviews against agreed expectations. Build individual learning and development plans for team members and ensure their execution through mentoring, training, technical assignments, and regular feedback. Develop QA Leads and Senior QA Engineers to independently own projects, testing areas, and team responsibilities. Track QA team performance through meaningful metrics such as testing completion, defect leakage, defect trends, release quality, blocker ageing, and planned versus completed work. Ensure appropriate test documentation including test plans, test cases, execution evidence, traceability, defect records, validation summaries, and release reports. Drive root-cause analysis for important production defects and recurring quality issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. Identify gaps in QA processes, tools, technical capability, documentation, and team structure and drive continuous improvements. Work closely with Engineering, Product, Program Management, Quality, and Regulatory teams to identify testing risks early and improve overall software quality. Drive adoption of appropriate AI-assisted testing, automation, and productivity tools where they can improve QA efficiency and effectiveness. 
 Years of Experience 12+ years of overall experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering. Minimum 4+ years of experience leading QA teams , preferably with QA Leads, Senior QA Engineers and QA Engineers reporting directly or indirectly. Experience managing QA across multiple products, projects, releases, and engineering teams simultaneously. Experience owning resource planning, hiring, performance management and team development. 
 Educational Background Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Candidate should be from a recognized Tier-1, Tier-2, or Tier-3 engineering college/university . 
 Technical Qualifications Strong understanding of software testing principles, test strategy, test planning, test design, and defect management. Strong experience testing Mobile, Web, Backend, APIs, and Databases . Good understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, compatibility, and end-to-end testing. Strong understanding of API and database testing and ability to investigate issues across different layers of the application. Ability to understand product architecture, integrations, data flows, dependencies, and technical risks sufficiently to define an effective testing strategy. Strong defect investigation, debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, test-management tools, API-testing tools, and reporting dashboards. Ability to define and track meaningful QA metrics and use data to identify quality, productivity, and process gaps. Familiarity with software validation, traceability, risk-based testing, change control, RCA, CAPA, and structured SDLC documentation is preferred. Experience with HealthTech, MedTech, regulated software, connected devices, or firmware testing is an advantage. 
 Non-Technical Qualifications Strong people-management skills with experience managing QA Leads, Senior QA Engineers, and QA Engineers. Strong capability in resource planning, hiring, performance management, mentoring, and employee development. Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Firmware, Quality, Regulatory, and leadership teams. Ability to provide clear technical and managerial direction to the QA team while enabling leads and senior team members to operate independently. Strong communication skills with the ability to present testing status, quality risks, resource constraints, and release readiness clearly to leadership. Comfortable challenging timelines or release decisions when testing evidence indicates significant quality or product risk. Strong coaching and feedback skills with the ability to identify performance gaps and take timely corrective actions. Strong planning, prioritization, and decision-making ability in an environment with multiple parallel projects and changing priorities. Process-oriented and detail-focused while maintaining a practical and execution-driven approach. Ability to build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, learning, automation, and quality engineering within the QA team.

Experience with Bluetooth/BLE, connected devices, firmware, or hardware-software integration testing . Experience testing systems involving algorithms, image processing, data pipelines, or complex backend workflows. Experience in HealthTech, MedTech, diagnostics, IoT, or other regulated product companies. Experience using AI-assisted testing or development tools to improve test generation, automation, debugging, documentation, or team productivity. Experience working in a fast-moving product organization with several projects and releases running simultaneously.

title: Pump Diagnostics and Condition Monitoring Engineer
description:
1. ABOUT PUMP ACADEMY PRIVATE LIMITED Pump Academy Private Limited (PAPL) is a DPIIT recognised deep tech IIoT startup headquartered in Bengaluru. We develop and deploy iPUMPNET, a patented AI and ML powered asset intelligence platform for pumping stations and water infrastructure, with three granted Indian patents and over two hundred live deployments across India. We work with water authorities, engineering consultants, power plants, and infrastructure operators to predict pump failures before they cause unplanned downtime and operational loss. 
 2. POSITION OVERVIEW We are hiring a full-time Pump Diagnostics and Condition Monitoring Engineer to establish and lead our in-house field diagnostics capability for detecting cavitation, recirculation, and other failure modes in rotating machinery. This role is critical to expanding iPUMPNET into power generation and large-scale pumping installations where real time fault detection and predictive maintenance are mission critical. You will be responsible for field diagnostic deployments, sensor integration, data interpretation, technical reporting to customers, and coordination with equipment vendors. 
 3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Field Diagnostics and Equipment Operation Conduct on site pump cavitation, recirculation, and bearing fault diagnostics using ultrasonic detection equipment (SDT270/SDT340), high frequency accelerometers, and broadband vibration analysis tools at customer installations. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot diagnostic equipment including ultrasonic detectors, ICP accelerometers, data acquisition hardware, and analysis software in field environments. Deploy non-invasive and invasive sensor techniques on operating equipment without disrupting customer operations; understand magnetic mounting, stud mounting, and contact probe placement for optimal signal capture. Data Analysis and Technical Interpretation Analyze time waveform and frequency spectrum data from vibration sensors to distinguish cavitation signatures (broadband random noise), recirculation pulsations (discrete peaks at vane pass frequency), bearing defects, and mechanical looseness. Interpret acoustic emission and ultrasonic signals from pump discharge, suction, and bearing regions to assess fault severity and rate of progression. Perform trending analysis on repeated measurements to track fault development over weeks and months, supporting predictive maintenance scheduling. Customer Engagement and Reporting Provide clear, technical but accessible diagnostic findings to customer stakeholders (plant operators, maintenance engineers, consulting engineers) in real time on site and in written reports. Recommend specific remedial actions (inlet pressure adjustment, flow rate changes, bearing replacement timing, design modifications) based on diagnostic findings and industry best practice. Build and maintain customer relationships; serve as the technical authority for PAPL's diagnostics services with water utilities, power plants, and consulting firms. Sensor Integration and Platform Development Work closely with PAPL's iPUMPNET platform team to integrate ultrasonic, accelerometer, and fluid borne noise data streams into the cloud analytics engine. Provide field derived insights on sensor placement, signal quality, sampling rates, and data transmission that inform hardware and firmware design for iPUMPNET modules. Validate algorithm performance in the field; confirm that fault detection and alert thresholds developed in the lab perform as intended on real customer pumps. Field Visits, Vibration Diagnostics and Safety Compliance Conduct vibration data collection as per company requirements and planned maintenance schedules. Perform impeller dynamic balancing as per company standards and requirements. Perform laser shaft alignment for rotating equipment as per company requirements and procedures. Visit customer sites as per the planned maintenance schedule and complete assigned field activities within the specified timeline. Coordinate with customer representatives before starting field activities and ensure proper communication throughout the work. Follow all company and customer safety procedures while carrying out field activities at customer sites. Ensure accurate data collection, proper documentation, and timely submission of field reports to the concerned team. 
 4. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline; or equivalent practical experience in rotating machinery condition monitoring. More than 5 years of hands-on experience with vibration analysis, condition monitoring, or predictive maintenance on boiler feed pumps, motors, compressors, or similar rotating equipment. Demonstrated proficiency with ultrasonic detection or acoustic emission equipment; experience with SDT ultrasound detectors, Flir AcoustiCam, or equivalent tools is a significant advantage. Strong working knowledge of vibration spectrum analysis, time waveform interpretation, and envelope analysis; comfort with FFT, frequency response functions, and signal filtering concepts. Field experience diagnosing pump cavitation, recirculation, bearing wear, or mechanical looseness in operating installations. Understanding of pump hydraulics: NPSH, inlet pressure, suction conditions, discharge backpressure, and how these factors affect cavitation onset and risk. Proficiency with data acquisition hardware and software (NI DAQ, LMS, Siemens Simcenter or equivalent). Ability to work independently in customer environments; comfortable with travel to multiple sites across India as required. Excellent technical communication skills; ability to explain diagnostic findings clearly to non-specialist stakeholders. Valid driver's license and willingness to travel by road and air to customer sites across India. 
 5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ISO 20816 (ISO 10816 legacy) or ISO 13373-1 certification in vibration analysis and condition monitoring. Experience with ICP (Integrated Circuit Piezoelectric) accelerometers and high frequency sensor systems. Background in power generation, water utilities, or large-scale pumping infrastructure. Experience with predictive maintenance programs in industrial settings. 
 6. WHAT WE OFFER More than best industry standard salary and benefits package commensurate with qualifications and experience. Opportunity to establish a new technical function at a rapidly growing IIoT startup with proven market traction. Direct involvement in cutting edge fault detection and predictive maintenance technology. Training and certification support; we will invest in your professional development and credentials. Access to premium diagnostic equipment; you will work with industry leading tools (SDT ultrasonic detectors, PCB Piezotronics sensors, advanced data acquisition systems). Exposure to diverse customer environments across India's water, power, and industrial sectors. Collaborative culture; you will work alongside software engineers, data scientists, and product managers building the next generation of asset intelligence platforms. 
 7. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience in pump diagnostics and condition monitoring, and any certifications (ISO 20816, ISO 13373-1, etc.) to hr@pumpacademy.in with the subject line 'Pump Diagnostics Engineer Application'. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a technical phone screening followed by in-person interviews in Bengaluru. Application deadline: Open until filled. For questions about this position, please contact hr@pumpacademy.in or reach out to Pump Academy at +91 77805 27412 during business hours.

Key Skills: Condition Monitoring,Predictive Maintenance,Vibration Analysis,Time Waveform Analysis,Vibration Analyst Certification,FFT Analysis,ISO 20816,Pump Diagnostics

title: Product Owner - Website Conversion & Growth
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a data driven, customer focused Product Owner to own the experience and performance of our high traffic lead generation website. Every visitor interaction on our site, from landing page to form submission, directly drives revenue. This role sits at the intersection of UI/UX, data analysis, and Agile product delivery. You will be the person who looks at a funnel drop off, forms a hypothesis about why it is happening, designs a test to validate it, and works with design and engineering to ship the fix, then measures the impact. This is not a role for someone who just writes tickets. It is for someone who thinks like a conversion strategist and executes like a Product Owner. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Conversion Optimization and Product Analytics (Core Focus) 
 Own the performance of key website funnels, including landing pages, forms, and conversion paths, with conversion rate as your north star metric. Analyze user behavior, session data, drop off points, and on site engagement to identify friction and opportunity. Form data backed hypotheses and translate them into a prioritized experimentation roadmap. Define, launch, and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests, and make clear ship, kill, or iterate calls based on results. Partner with design and engineering to turn insights into shipped UI/UX improvements such as page layout, form design, copy, page speed, mobile experience, and trust signals. Report on outcomes in terms stakeholders care about, including conversion lift, lead volume, lead quality, and revenue impact. 
 
 Product Vision and Roadmap 
 Translate business goals, such as more leads, better lead quality, and higher conversion, into a clear, prioritized backlog. Build and maintain a roadmap focused on funnel and website enhancements. Keep an eye on competitor sites and industry UX and CRO trends, and bring relevant ideas back to the team. 
 
 Requirements and Documentation 
 Turn business needs and test hypotheses into clear user stories and acceptance criteria. Prepare lightweight, useful Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) that are clear enough for engineering and design to build from, without unnecessary overhead. Maintain release notes and document key product and test decisions and their outcomes, so learnings compound over time. 
 
 Stakeholder Management 
 Act as the main link between business stakeholders and the development team. Present roadmap progress and experiment results in a way that is clear to both technical and non technical audiences. Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and trade offs, and know when to push back on a request that will not move the needle on conversion. 
 
 Qualifications Experience 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, Design, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2 to 4 years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, CRO Specialist, or similar role, ideally with direct exposure to high traffic websites, landing pages, or lead generation funnels. A track record of using data to improve conversion, not just shipping features, but proving they worked. Solid experience with Agile/Scrum, including backlog management, sprint planning, and writing detailed user stories and acceptance criteria. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Experience with website conversion optimization strongly preferred. 
 
 Skills 
 Strong grasp of UI/UX principles and how design decisions affect user behavior and conversion. Comfortable reading and interpreting web analytics, session recordings, heatmaps, and A/B test results to draw actionable conclusions. Specific tools matter less than the underlying analytical thinking. Working knowledge of Agile tooling such as JIRA or similar. This is a good to have, not a must have, as long as you understand iterative, sprint based product development. Basic technical literacy, including an understanding of APIs, databases, and web architecture well enough to have informed conversations with engineering. 
 
 How You Work 
 Genuinely customer centric. You want to understand why users behave the way they do, not just what the numbers say. Strong communicator who can present data and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at every level. Decisive prioritizer, comfortable making trade off calls with incomplete information. Leads through influence. You will not manage this team directly, but you drive alignment and momentum anyway. Comfortable in a fast moving environment where hypotheses get tested and iterated quickly.

title: Product Innovation and Design Manager
description:
Department: Product & Design 
 Industry: Information & Technology, preferably Logistics & Freight 
 Location: Pune / Remote 
 Experience Range: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience; at least 3 years hands-on in Figma and design prototyping; 2+ years Product Management or managing product design team 
 Basic Qualification: BE/B-TECH/MCA/BCA or bachelor's degree in a related subject; formal design qualification (HCI, Interaction Design, Visual Design) strongly preferred 
 Travel Requirements: No 
 Website: www.quloi.com 
 Our mission Our mission is to Quantifying all activities for logistics stakeholders. 
 Our Vision Our vision is to Enable businesses to make the best logistics decisions. 
 Whats the Role? We are looking for a Product Innovation and Design Manager who is equally at home defining a new product concept and opening Figma to prototype it themselves. This is a senior role that combines: the strategic product thinking to identify and incubate new solutions, the hands-on design craft to bring those concepts to life using Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools such as Claude Design, and the management experience to lead and grow Qulois UX team. You will own the full arc from discovery to validated prototype — running user research, shaping product direction, designing and iterating in Figma, and leveraging Claude Design to accelerate high-fidelity prototyping before a single line of production code is written. Once a new module or solution is validated, you need to follow the Product basics and prepare the BRD, PRD and make sure the solution is documented properly. 
 Responsibilities/ Duties 1. Lead New Feature Discovery and Incubation: Identify opportunities for entirely new product modules/features by monitoring industry trends, competitor products, regulatory developments, and evolving logistics standards. Define proof-of-concept criteria and validate new concepts with pilot customers before committing engineering resources to full development. Maintain an innovation backlog — a prioritised pipeline of ideas at different validation stages — reviewed regularly with the Head of Product and leadership. Own the structured Product process from validated new modules to ensuring design assets, and product requirements are fully documented. 2. Design and Prototype Hands-On in Figma and Claude Design: Create wireframes, interaction flows, and high-fidelity UI designs directly in Figma for all new product initiatives and innovation concepts. Use Claude Design to rapidly generate and iterate on prototypes, accelerating the design-to-validation cycle and exploring a broader solution space before committing to a direction. Build and maintain a shared Figma component library and design system that all product surfaces — core and local versions — draw from, ensuring visual and interaction consistency across the platform. Produce handoff-ready design specifications, annotated prototypes, and developer notes that engineering teams can implement without ambiguity. 3. Lead and Develop the UX Team: Manage and mentor the UX team (UX researchers, interaction designers, UI designers), setting clear goals, development plans, and quality standards. Own the UX team roadmap and ensure design capacity is allocated across innovation initiatives, core product enhancements, and local version requirements — coordinated through the AI PM Orchestrator. Conduct structured design reviews and hold a consistently high bar for usability, accessibility, and visual quality across all Quloi product surfaces. Actively develop team members’ skills in AI-assisted design tooling, including Claude Design, as part of the team’s ongoing capability uplift. 4. Drive UX Research for New Solutions: Plan and lead UX research activities (user interviews, usability testing, journey mapping, contextual inquiry) to validate new module concepts at every stage. Synthesise research findings into clear product requirements, design briefs, and prioritised problem statements that both the UX team and engineering can act on. Ensure user insight drives every design decision — from initial concept sketch to final prototype — rather than being a one-time input at the start of discovery. 5. Collaborate Across the PM Organisation: Work with the VP of Product to ensure new modules are architecturally and visually compatible with the existing platform — building on the existing product database rather than rebuilding from scratch. Brief Local Version PMs on new modules entering the pipeline early enough for regional design requirements to be incorporated in the initial Figma files. Participate in cross-PM syncs and AI PM Orchestrator-led workflows covering documentation, Confluence pages, and Jira ticket hygiene. 6. Measure Innovation and Design Impact: Define success metrics at the proof-of-concept stage for each new module (e.g., pilot adoption rate, task completion in usability tests, stakeholder confidence score, prototype-to-build time saved via Claude Design). Track UX team performance including design delivery cycle time, usability test scores, design system adoption rate, and cross-team satisfaction. Report innovation pipeline status, prototype velocity, and UX team throughput to leadership on a regular cadence. 
 Criteria for the Role! Experience: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience. Candidates with only a PM background and no hands-on design craft, or only a design background with no PM experience, will not be considered. Figma Proficiency: Advanced Figma skills are non-negotiable — you must be able to independently produce wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs, interactive prototypes, and a structured component library to a professional standard. Claude Design Experience: Demonstrated experience using Claude Design or equivalent AI-powered prototyping tools to generate, iterate on, and validate product concepts. Ability to brief, prompt, and critically evaluate AI-generated design output. UX Team Management: Minimum 2 years of formal people management responsibility for a UX or product design team, including goal-setting, performance development, and capacity planning. 0-to-1 Product Experience: Proven track record of taking a new product concept from initial idea to validated proof-of-concept in a B2B SaaS environment. Portfolio evidence is required. UX Research Fluency: Hands-on experience planning and conducting user research (not just commissioning it). You know when to run a usability test versus a user interview, and can do both yourself when needed. Design Systems: Experience building and governing a shared component library or design system used by multiple teams or product surfaces. Industry Domain knowledge is a strong advantage: Strong interest in logistics, supply chain, or trade technology; able to understand an industry standard or regulatory document and translate it into a product and design implication. Platform Awareness: Understands multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture at a conceptual level; designs with component reuse, localisation, and scalability in mind from the first wireframe. Communication: Able to present early-stage, ambiguous concepts confidently to senior stakeholders and translate feedback into actionable design and product decisions. Tooling: Figma (advanced), Claude Design, Jira, Confluence. Familiarity with handoff tools (Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin) and user testing platforms (Maze, UserTesting, Lookback) is an advantage.

title: Sr. Hardware Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 A Senior Hardware Engineer and future leader who designs embedded product hardware end to end: architecture, power, analog, digital, microcontroller and communication interfaces - and then proves it on the bench. You will take products from requirements to a validated board, working alongside firmware, QA and manufacturing, across medical, industrial and IoT products. The person we are looking for owns the whole board, not just the schematic: they select components with supply and cost in mind, design for the enclosure and the test jig, and treat bring-up as part of design, not someone else s problem. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Architecture and Design 
 Work with the development team and product managers to define product hardware architecture. Design embedded product hardware as per requirements: power supply, analog, digital, microcontroller and communication interface sections. Select components balancing performance, availability, cost and lifecycle. Design and develop schematics in Altium Designer. 
 
 Layout and Manufacturing Hand-off 
 Design PCB layouts in Altium considering EMI/EMC and enclosure requirements, or guide a layout engineer doing so. Generate Gerber files and coordinate with PCB manufacturers on ordering, queries and delivery. Handle component procurement for prototypes and coordinate with the prototype assembly team. 
 
 Bring-up, Debug and Collaboration 
 Lead board bring-up, debugging and problem solving on your designs. Coordinate with the firmware team on hardware-firmware integration and with QA on validation. Mentor junior hardware engineers and review their schematics and layouts. 
 
 Technical Skills Required 
 Hardware Design: 5 to 7 years designing embedded product hardware: discrete, power and microcontroller-based designs. Power Analog: Power supply design (DC-DC, LDO), analog signal conditioning, protection circuits. Altium Designer: Schematic and PCB design; multilayer and mixed-signal boards. Memory Interfaces: Flash, eMMC, SDRAM, DDR2/3/4 design and integration. Interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART on-board; USB, Ethernet external interfaces. Wireless: BLE, Wi-Fi, RF, LoRa integration experience. Bring-up Debug: Board bring-up, systematic fault isolation, bench instruments (oscilloscope, logic analyser, multimeter). Collaboration: Strong communication; comfortable in a fast-paced Agile / Scrum environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills (Added Advantage) 
 Experience on medical devices or other regulated products (CE, FCC, UL, BIS, ISO 13485 awareness). EMI/EMC pre-compliance testing exposure and design-for-compliance practices. Working knowledge of embedded C to aid hardware-firmware debugging. Experience in a product design services or contract development environment. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Engineering graduate in an Electronics-based branch. 5 to 7 years of experience in embedded hardware design. Good verbal and written communication in English. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your boards go from schematic review to validated bring-up with few surprises. Firmware engineers trust your designs and your judgement during integration debugging. Junior engineers improve measurably from your reviews and mentoring.
