title: Product Manager
description:
We're hiring Product Manager E-commerce, CRO & AI Products Own the customer journey for CrazyNeon, a fast-growing custom signage brand serving customers across the US and beyond. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data, and applied AI — not a typical roadmap-and-tickets PM job. Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.Gurgaon • On-siteProduct & Growth4–8 yearsFull-time 
 About CrazyNeon CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd. We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI. 
 About the role We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences. This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen. A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage. The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person. 
 What you'll do 1. E-commerce product management Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase. Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase. Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs. Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements. Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion. Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting. 2. Conversion rate optimization CRO is a major part of this role. Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end. Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off. Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems. Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments. Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements. Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience. Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey. 3. Data & analytics Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities. Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance. Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working. Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations. Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment. 4. Customer research Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy. Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities. Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful. Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve. Turn customer problems into clear product requirements. 5. AI & new-age products A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations. Potential areas include: AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation AI artwork analysis and preflight AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery AI-assisted quoting and configuration AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation Internal AI knowledge systems for employees You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production. You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do. 6. Product strategy & roadmap Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance. Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design. Set KPIs for every major initiative. 7. Experimentation & innovation We want someone who's constantly asking: "What can we do differently?" Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well. Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge. Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources. Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement. 
 What we're looking for Must-have 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar. Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels. Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs. Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools. Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions. Experience working closely with developers and designers. Solid understanding of UX/UI principles. Strong communication and project management skills. A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue. Nice to have Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands. Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar. Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms. Experience building or shipping AI-powered products. Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation. Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools. Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce. 
 Who thrives in this role Data-driven — you look at the numbers before making product calls. Customer-obsessed — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do. Commercially minded — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value. Experimentation-oriented — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks. Technically curious — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology. AI-curious — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype. Entrepreneurial — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap. Hands-on — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish. 
 How we'll measure success Website conversion rate Revenue per visitor Add-to-cart rate Checkout conversion Lead-to-order conversion Average order value Revenue from new product experiences Adoption of new digital/AI products Customer engagement Number & quality of experiments run Reduction in customer friction / manual work 
 Why join CrazyNeon? This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience. You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact. If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit. Product & Growth • Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd. • Gurgaon (On-site)

title: Business Dev Manager, Retail (Custom Development and Product Sales)
description:
Education Qualification 
 Bachelor or Master Degree 
 
 Job Summary 
 EvinceDev is looking for a Business Development Manager to grow our Retail and Consumer business in the United States. The role covers two types of sales: custom software development projects and ready to deploy software products. You will build your own pipeline and close deals with minimal supervision. You should be able to run a full product demo, handle build versus buy discussions, turn pilots into paid contracts, and explain clearly where a product ends and custom development begins. You will work with founders, CTOs and CIOs, as well as retail leaders such as VP Ecommerce, VP Digital and COO. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Define and refine the ideal customer profile (ICP) for Retail and Consumer, including target segments, filters, buying triggers and exclusions. Build target account lists using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, StoreLeads, BuiltWith or similar tools. Run outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, calls and planned follow ups, and write your own messaging. Sell both custom development projects and software products, and recommend the right option for each account. Deliver product demos tailored to each client's workflow. Guide build versus buy discussions with honest advice. Run pilots and proofs of concept with clear goals and timelines, and convert them into paid contracts. Work with presales and solution architects on the solution approach, phasing and pricing. Prepare, present and close deals on time and material, fixed bid, dedicated team, licence and subscription models. Include a support, maintenance or extension plan with every deal. Share competitor insights, feature gaps and client objections with the product team. Keep pipeline, next steps and forecasts current in HubSpot CRM. 
 
 Must Have Skills 
 Communication, Presentation and Demo Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear and confident style suited to US founders, CTOs and CIOs. Professional presence in meetings with senior technical and business leaders. Candidates will give a live presentation during the interview. Ability to run a solution walkthrough, architecture discussion or product demo without needing an engineer on the first call. Ability to contribute to account strategy, solution approach and commercial planning. Ability to answer detailed technical questions from a CTO or CIO with confidence. Ability to engage technical buyers (CTO, CIO, VP Engineering) and retail leaders (VP Ecommerce, VP Digital, COO, Head of Stores) in the same meeting. Availability to work with a large overlap with US business hours, including evening calls. 
 
 Retail Knowledge 
 4+ years of selling technology services or products to Retail, Consumer or Ecommerce businesses in the US. Working knowledge of at least three areas: POS and store systems, order management and fulfilment, inventory and warehouse operations, merchandising and pricing, loyalty and CRM or CDP, supply chain. Understanding of retail metrics such as conversion, average order value, margin, stock accuracy, fulfilment cost and returns. Awareness of retail peak seasons and code freeze periods, and how they affect buying and delivery timelines. Ability to discuss integrations between commerce, ERP, OMS, WMS, POS and finance systems. Ability to explain technology benefits in terms retail teams care about, such as order accuracy, stock accuracy, time saved and customer experience. 
 
 Custom Development Sales 
 Proven experience selling custom software development and engineering services. Working knowledge of the software delivery lifecycle, including discovery, estimation, sprints, releases, QA and support. Ability to discuss cloud, APIs and integrations, data platforms, web and mobile apps, and AI features at a business level. Ability to prepare clear proposals and statements of work covering scope, assumptions, exclusions and commercial terms. Preference for a paid discovery phase before committing to a build estimate. 
 
 Product Sales Knowledge 
 Proven experience selling a software product or platform, in addition to services. Understanding of product pricing models such as perpetual licence, subscription, usage based, per store or per location, and tiered plans, and how each affects deal size and renewals. Ability to deliver a complete product demo independently, tailored to the client's workflow and data. Ability to handle build versus buy, roadmap and customisation questions without overpromising. Experience running pilots or proofs of concept with clear success criteria and converting them into paid contracts. Clear understanding of where the product ends and custom development begins, and how to price each part. Regular sharing of lost deal reasons, feature gaps and pricing feedback with the product team. 
 
 Outbound and ICP Knowledge 
 Strong ICP knowledge, with the ability to define who to target, who to avoid, and why. Prior experience building or working a Retail or Ecommerce ICP, including which segments buy custom development, which buy products, and which buy neither. Proven success in building your own outbound pipeline. Hands on experience with Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, StoreLeads, BuiltWith, Clay or similar tools. Ability to write outbound messages that get replies from senior technical leaders, and to improve them based on results. Experience using buying signals such as funding rounds, leadership changes, product launches, technology migrations, new engineering roles and regulatory or seasonal deadlines. Consistent follow up across email, LinkedIn and phone, with a personal tone in every message. 
 
 Closing and Ownership 
 A track record of closing deals personally, from first contact to signed contract. Closed business in custom development or technology services, with deal size, sales cycle and buyer details you can walk us through. Ability to work independently and manage your own pipeline, calendar and priorities. Strong negotiation on rates, scope and terms without relying on discounts. Accurate forecasting and up to date records in HubSpot CRM. Habit of adding a support, maintenance or extension plan to every deal. 
 
 Primary Skills Tools 
 Executive Presentation, Product Demos, Client Communication. Product Sales: Licensing, Subscriptions, Pilots and Proofs of Concept. Custom Software Development Sales, Proposal and SOW Writing. Retail Domain: POS, OMS, Inventory, Merchandising, Loyalty, Supply Chain. ICP Definition, Outbound Lead Generation, Pipeline Management, Deal Closure. 
 
 Good To Have 
 An existing network among US retail and consumer brands or retail technology companies. Familiarity with commerce platforms such as Shopify Plus, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce or commercetools. Familiarity with retail systems such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, Lightspeed or Square. Experience with unified commerce or omnichannel programmes. Experience selling to franchise, dealer or multi location businesses. Knowledge of subscription commerce, loyalty and retention programmes. Participation in retail events such as NRF, Shoptalk or Groceryshop. Experience working alongside platform partners. Exposure to headless or composable commerce.

title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager (TDM)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE Rafay is seeking a hands-on Senior Technical Program Management to lead strategic customer deployments and drive execution across Rafay s Kubernetes and GPU PaaS platform initiatives. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for overseeing complex enterprise implementations while remaining deeply engaged in technical delivery, customer architecture discussions, and cross-functional execution. 
 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, GPU/AI workloads, and enterprise platform delivery. This leader will serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, helping drive successful onboarding, modernization, migration, and adoption initiatives across large-scale enterprise environments. Unlike a traditional people-management-only director role, this position requires hands-on involvement in technical project execution, customer solutioning, escalation management, and operational leadership. 
 TOP 3 REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE 
 - Proven leadership managing complex enterprise technical programs and customer-facing implementations in cloud, Kubernetes, AI/ML, or infrastructure environments. 
 - Deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, GPU workloads, cloud platforms, containers, and modern infrastructure architectures. 
 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence customer leadership, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 - Lead and oversee strategic customer implementations for Rafay s Kubernetes and GPU PaaS platform offerings across EMEA. 
 - Serve as the primary technical program leader for large-scale onboarding, migration, modernization, and platform adoption initiatives. 
 - Drive program execution across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements while maintaining hands-on involvement in technical planning and delivery. 
 - Partner directly with customer engineering, platform, infrastructure, DevOps, and executive stakeholders to define scope, align priorities, and ensure successful outcomes. 
 - Lead customer discovery workshops, architecture reviews, technical planning sessions, and implementation governance. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, and Partner teams to align delivery priorities and remove execution blockers. 
 - Provide technical leadership and guidance around Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, cloud-native architectures, AI/ML platform deployments, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud implementations. 
 - Establish scalable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, operational best practices, and program governance frameworks. 
 - Own program risk management, escalation handling, dependency tracking, and executive-level communication throughout the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive accountability across internal and external teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations. 
 - Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer issues, deployment challenges, and critical implementation risks. 
 - Mentor and guide TPMs, solutions architects, and technical delivery resources while helping scale Rafay s customer delivery organization. 
 - Maintain hands-on familiarity with supporting technologies and frameworks including Observability, DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, FinOps, GPU orchestration, and cloud infrastructure tooling. 
 - Contribute to strategic initiatives that improve customer onboarding, operational efficiency, deployment automation, and overall customer experience. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 - Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software delivery. 
 - 5+ years leading complex enterprise customer deployments involving Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, infrastructure modernization, or AI/ML platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on technical expertise with Kubernetes, containers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, infrastructure, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional technical teams in fast-paced startup or high-growth technology environments. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud operations, infrastructure scalability, and modernization initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to communicate effectively with executives, architects, engineers, and customer stakeholders. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent programs with complex dependencies and executive visibility. 
 - Preferred certifications include PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, CKA/CKAD, or equivalent cloud/Kubernetes certifications.

This role is a business partner to the functional head, with responsibilities of developing, reporting, analysing, and presenting metrics across multiple business functions within Global Regulatory Affairs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to present information in a clear and concise manner with the ability to interact with various levels of management. Apply secure methods for handling API credentials, SFTP keys, secrets, and other sensitive configuration information. Performance Optimization Analyse and optimize Spark workloads using appropriate: Data-partitioning strategies Join and broadcast strategies Caching and persistence Shuffle optimization Data-skew handling Query execution plans File-compaction and small-file management techniques Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks in PySpark, Spark SQL, SQL, and Delta Lake pipelines. Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to the Technical Lead or Project Manager. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data-quality issues, performance problems, and production incidents. Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective and preventive solutions. Develop restart, retry, recovery, and reconciliation mechanisms for failed or partially completed pipeline executions. Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and support runbooks. Agentic AIEnabled Development Use Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar agentic AI-enabled IDEs to improve development productivity. Use AI development tools for: Generating and refactoring PySpark, Python, and SQL code Creating unit tests and data-validation scripts Debugging pipeline failures Identifying potential performance improvements Generating technical documentation and code explanations Write effective prompts and provide relevant technical context to AI development tools. Review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance with coding standards. Ensure that confidential data, credentials, and proprietary information are handled according to organizational security and AI-usage policies. Strong understanding of Apache Spark architecture and distributed data processing. Experience designing and developing enterprise-scale ETL/ELT data pipelines.  * Drawing registers

title: UAV / DRONE SYSTEMS INTEGRATION ENGINEER
description:
Overview We are looking for a technically strong and hands-on UAV / Drone Systems Integration Engineer to join our R&D team and contribute to the development, integration, validation and field deployment of advanced unmanned aerial systems. The role spans the complete UAV development cycle-from system-level understanding and component selection to hardware/software integration, flight testing, troubleshooting and performance validation. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable in the laboratory, at the workbench and on the flight-testing field. The position covers multirotor and VTOL platforms, autopilot systems, propulsion, navigation, communication, payload integration and emerging UAV technologies. The engineer will also participate in customer demonstrations and defence-sector trials, where disciplined testing, technical judgement, documentation and professional conduct are essential. Responsibilities Own UAV integration activities across multirotor, heavy-lift and VTOL platforms, from subsystem integration through ground validation and flight trials. Translate mission and system requirements into practical selections of flight controllers, propulsion, ESCs, batteries, navigation sensors, communication links and payload interfaces. Integrate and configure PX4 and ArduPilot systems, including sensor calibration, flight modes, failsafes, mission configuration and flight-parameter tuning. Use Mission Planner and QGroundControl for configuration, mission planning, telemetry monitoring, parameter management and post-flight analysis. Perform electrical, mechanical and software-level integration of motors, ESCs, power systems, GNSS/GPS, telemetry, RC systems, cameras, payloads and auxiliary sensors. Support VTOL development, including actuator/servo integration, hover and forward-flight configuration, transition testing, stabilization and troubleshooting. Conduct structured ground and flight tests; identify root causes of instability, navigation errors, communication issues, vibration, power-system problems and other system-level failures. Analyze autopilot flight logs and test data to support engineering decisions and performance improvement. Evaluate and integrate technologies such as RTK/GNSS, optical flow, VPS/VIO, advanced telemetry, autonomous navigation and computer-vision payloads. Participate in prototype development, engineering validation, field demonstrations and defence-sector trials, including preparation, on-site integration and post-trial reporting. Maintain integration procedures, wiring/interface documentation, configuration records, test plans, flight-test reports, issue logs and lessons learned. Work with embedded, electronics, mechanical and software teams to resolve cross-disciplinary integration issues. Research emerging UAV technologies, evaluate feasibility and support proof-of-concept development. Travel to customer locations, test ranges and field sites when required. Technical Skills Required Strong system-level understanding of UAV architecture covering flight-control, propulsion, power, navigation, communication and payload subsystems. Hands-on experience with multirotor platforms; understanding of heavy-lift UAV integration is desirable. Working knowledge of VTOL architectures and hover, transition and forward-flight integration. Hands-on experience with PX4 and/or ArduPilot, including parameter configuration, calibration, flight modes, failsafes and basic tuning. Proficiency with Mission Planner and/or QGroundControl. Good understanding of motor-propeller matching, ESC selection, battery sizing, power budgeting, thrust-to-weight, endurance and payload trade-offs. Understanding of GNSS/GPS, telemetry, RC links and UAV communication interfaces. Practical knowledge of UART, I2C, SPI, CAN and PWM. Ability to read basic schematics/wiring diagrams and diagnose electrical and integration problems. Ability to conduct systematic flight tests, analyze logs and convert observations into engineering actions. Working understanding of UAV safety, pre-flight procedures, risk assessment, test discipline and configuration control. Preferred Skills Experience with VTOL / QuadPlane / tailsitter or other hybrid UAV architectures. Experience with custom flight controllers, STM32-based electronics or embedded UAV systems. Exposure to RTK GNSS, dual-GNSS, optical flow, VPS, VIO or GPS-denied navigation. Understanding of autonomous navigation, waypoint missions, geofencing, failsafe strategies and mission execution. Exposure to computer vision, AI/ML, companion computers or perception systems. Experience integrating cameras, gimbals, telemetry modules, digital video links or mission payloads. Basic C/C++ and/or Python for UAV automation, data analysis or hardware interfacing. Experience with SITL/HITL or other UAV simulation and validation methods. Exposure to RF/communication systems, long-range telemetry or advanced RC systems. Strong analytical approach to debugging, root-cause analysis and engineering problem solving. Ability to independently research, test and integrate unfamiliar UAV technologies. Defence / Field Trials & Professional Requirements Willingness to participate in defence-sector demonstrations, customer evaluations, trials and field deployments. Ability to work under field conditions and coordinate professionally with customers, test teams and technical stakeholders. Strong discipline in pre-flight checks, configuration management, safety procedures and trial documentation. Ability to communicate technical findings, test results, limitations and recommendations clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required for UAV trials, integration activities and customer demonstrations. Experience 1-2 years of relevant hands-on experience in UAV/drone development, integration, testing or R&D. Practical UAV experience is required; the role is not intended for candidates with only theoretical knowledge or drone-piloting experience. Experience across both hardware and software aspects of UAV integration will be highly valued. Engineering backgrounds in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Aerospace, Aeronautical, Embedded Systems or related disciplines are preferred. Candidates with strong project/research experience in UAV systems are encouraged to apply. Compensation: u20b945,000-u20b955,000 per month, commensurate with technical depth, hands-on capability and relevant experience. What We Value We value engineers who can move beyond individual components and understand the UAV as an integrated system. description:
Job Summary 
 Design Verification Engineer Automotive Connectivity SoCs and E2B Technology As a Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will develop verification environments and execute verification activities for next-generation automotive connectivity SoCs based on E2B technology. You will work on complex devices incorporating embedded processors, digital communication subsystems, firmware, security functions, and mixed-signal components. Working with moderate supervision, you will collaborate with design, architecture, firmware, functional safety, and validation teams to ensure that designs meet their functional, quality, and reliability requirements before tape-out. You will contribute to SystemVerilog/UVM testbench development, C DPI integration, coverage analysis, regression execution, and debugging of hardware-software interactions. This position provides an opportunity to develop expertise in automotive SoC verification while contributing to technologies that enable reliable, high-performance in-vehicle connectivity. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Verification Environment Development: Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments, including agents, sequences, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and functional coverage. SoC Verification: Verify SoC functionality involving embedded processors, memories, interconnects, interrupts, DMA controllers, peripherals, communication interfaces, and mixed-signal subsystems. Verification Planning: Contribute to verification plans by translating design and product requirements into test scenarios, coverage items, and verification objectives. Test Development: Develop directed and constrained-random tests for block-level, subsystem-level, and SoC-level verification. Processor-Based Verification: Develop and execute verification scenarios for microprocessor-based SoCs, including processor initialization, register accesses, interrupts, exceptions, boot sequences, and basic firmware interactions. C DPI Integration: Develop and maintain C/SystemVerilog DPI interfaces and integrate C-based models or reference functions into simulation environments. E2B Functionality: Verify E2B communication functionality, including configuration, control, data transfer, timing behavior, error handling, diagnostics, and recovery scenarios. Coverage and Metrics: Analyze functional, code, and assertion coverage; identify verification gaps; and develop additional tests to support verification closure. Regression Execution: Execute and monitor verification regressions, analyze failures, classify issues, and communicate results to the project team. Debugging: Analyze and resolve verification failures across testbenches, RTL, embedded C code, reference models, and system-level scenarios. Functional Safety Support: Contribute to verification of automotive safety mechanisms, fault injection tests, requirements traceability, and verification evidence for ISO 26262-related activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with design, architecture, firmware, functional safety, validation, and applications teams to resolve technical issues and support project milestones.

The person we are looking for sweats footprints and stack-ups, thinks about EMI and the enclosure before routing the first trace, and stays with the board through fabrication, assembly and bring-up rather than throwing Gerbers over the wall. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Schematic and Library Work Work with the development team on schematic design as per product requirements. Design and develop schematics in Altium Designer. Create and maintain component and footprint libraries for new components - correct the footprint once, not on three boards. PCB Layout Design PCB layouts in Altium considering EMI/EMC requirements, enclosure constraints, thermal behaviour and DFM/DFA. Route high-speed and impedance-controlled sections: memory interfaces, USB, Ethernet, differential pairs. Build 3D models to verify component placement and enclosure fitment before fabrication, not after. Generate clean fabrication outputs: Gerbers, drill files, assembly drawings, pick-and-place. Prototype Coordination Coordinate with PCB manufacturers on ordering, technical queries and delivery. Handle component procurement for prototypes, including alternates when parts are unavailable. Coordinate with the prototype assembly team and support the hardware team during bring-up of your boards. 
 
 Technical Skills Required 
 Altium Designer: Expertise in schematic and PCB design; multilayer and mixed-signal boards. High-Speed Layout: Multilayer high-speed design: impedance control, length matching, differential pairs, return paths. MCU-based Designs: Layout for 32-bit microcontroller-based designs and their supporting circuits. Memory Interfaces: Flash, eMMC, SDRAM, DDR2/DDR3/DDR4 - routing, termination and timing constraints. Interfaces: On-board (SPI, I2C) and external (USB, Ethernet) interface layout. Wireless: Layout for BLE, Wi-Fi, RF, LoRa sections: antenna keep-outs, matching networks, ground strategy. EMI / EMC: Layout practices for emissions and immunity; awareness of CE/FCC pre-compliance implications. Ways of Working: Comfortable in a fast-paced Agile / Scrum development environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills (Added Advantage) 
 Experience on medical device boards, or other regulated/compliance-driven products. Thermal analysis basics: copper pours, thermal vias, dissipation planning. Exposure to signal integrity tools or post-layout simulation. Experience in a product design services or contract development environment. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Engineering graduate in an Electronics-based branch or equivalent. 2 to 4 years of experience in PCB design. Good verbal and written communication in English. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Boards you lay out come back working, with rework the exception rather than the rule. Fabrication and assembly houses rarely need to call about your output package. Library parts you create are trusted and reused across projects.

title: Hardware Electronic Design Engineer (M.Tech)
description:
Hardware Electronic Design Engineer (M.Tech) Location: Viman Nagar, Pune Department: Electronics / Hardware Design Employment Type: Full-Time. 
 Position Overview We are seeking an M.Tech Hardware Electronic Design Engineer with strong first-principles circuit design ability, capable of taking a product from concept to validated hardware. This is a design origination role, not a schematic-copying or layout-only role . The candidate is expected to generate original electronic hardware architectures, substantiate them with independent design calculations and analysis, and carry them through schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, and qualification. The role spans two areas. The first is power electronic and embedded hardware, including power conversion stages, drive and control electronics, and digital and analog embedded boards for rectifiers, inverters, UPS, SMPS, and power converters. The second is sensor, control, and communication hardware for portable, handheld, and ruggedized products, requiring low-power design, robust interfacing, and electromagnetic and environmental hardening. Both industrial and ruggedized or defence-grade applications are covered. The candidate will work closely with mechanical, PCB fabrication, firmware, manufacturing, quality, and project teams. 
 Role & responsibilities Develop original hardware architectures and topologies for new products from customer specifications, functional requirements, and system-level constraints. Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power electronic circuits, including power supplies, DC-DC converters, drivers, protection circuits, sensor front ends, and microcontroller or FPGA/DSP-based embedded boards. Perform independent design calculations covering power budget, efficiency and losses, component derating, thermal dissipation, worst-case timing and tolerance analysis, signal and power integrity, EMI/EMC margins, and reliability (MTBF) Select and size power semiconductors, magnetics, filters, and heat-dissipating components, and coordinate with mechanical design on heat sinking, thermal interface, and cooling. Design hardware for shock, vibration, and transportation environments, including component mounting, conformal coating, and connector and cable selection for ruggedized equipment. Design sensor, control, and communication hardware for sealed portable and handheld products, meeting low-power and battery-operated constraints. repare schematics, PCB stack-up and layout guidelines, Bills of Materials, and interconnect and cable diagrams, and review PCB layouts for correctness, manufacturability, and EMI/EMC compliance. Ensure hardware design meets EMI/EMC, creepage and clearance, earthing and bonding, isolation, safety, and ingress-protection interface requirements in coordination with mechanical design. Interface with vendors and suppliers on component sourcing, PCB fabrication feasibility, and first-article inspection. Prepare design documentation, calculation sheets, design review records, test reports, and product release documentation. Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to design standardisation and product innovation. Work with mechanical, firmware, and software teams for product integration. 
 Preferred candidate profile Masters in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline (mandatory). 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in hardware/electronic product design, preferably for power electronic, embedded, electrical, or ruggedized equipment. Fresh M.Tech graduates with a strong design thesis/project background may also be considered. Demonstrated record of designing new hardware, not only modifying or debugging existing designs. Candidates should be prepared to discuss circuits they personally originated. Ability to carry out power, thermal, signal-integrity, and reliability calculations independently, and to defend the assumptions behind them in a design review. Strong command of schematic capture and PCB design tools (Altium Designer, OrCAD, Cadence Allegro, or KiCad), including multi-layer, high-speed, and mixed-signal layout. Hands-on circuit simulation capability (LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent) and familiarity with thermal simulation for electronic assemblies. Demonstrated experience delivering hardware qualified for EMI/EMC compliance, including filter design, shielding, grounding schemes, and resolution of emission or susceptibility failures found in testing. Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: switch-mode topologies, magnetics design, gate drive, and protection circuit design. Sound understanding of analog and digital electronics, embedded microcontroller/FPGA interfacing, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet), and basic firmware bring-up support. Proficiency with lab instrumentation: oscilloscopes, DMMs, power analysers, logic analysers, and spectrum/network analysers, for board bring-up and debug. Familiarity with applicable standards for electronic hardware and ruggedized equipment, such as IEC/EN 61000 series EMI/EMC, MIL-STD-461 electromagnetic compatibility, MIL-STD-810 environmental, and IPC-2221/IPC-A-610 PCB design and assembly standards, will be an added advantage. Strong analytical ability, ownership, communication skills, and willingness to work hands-on with prototypes and on the shop floor. Added Advantage The following are not essential requirements, but will be considered favourably: Exposure to the design of fuze electronics, safety and arming electronics, or other precision electro-mechanical armament sub-system hardware. Familiarity with fuze safety design criteria and qualification standards such as MIL-STD-1316, STANAG 4187, and MIL-STD-331, and with fuze safety review, certification, and clearance processes. Experience in precision, low-power sensor and trigger circuit design, including inertial sensing, timing circuits, and initiation/firing circuit hardware. Experience designing hardware that must survive severe launch, setback, spin, and impact environments, supported by explicit shock and vibration qualification. Experience designing for long-term storage without maintenance, including component derating for shelf life, battery/primary-cell interface design, and corrosion- and moisture-resistant hardening. Exposure to air gun, centrifuge, jolt, jumble, and drop testing of armament or precision electronic sub-systems. Experience preparing hazard analyses, FMEA, fault trees, and safety documentation for review by certification or safety authorities. 
 Interested candidates may apply with their updated rsum along with details of hardware/electronic designs they have personally originated, including the design calculations, analysis, and validation carried out for them. Candidates are encouraged to include examples of both power electronic/embedded board work and sensor, control, or communication hardware work where available.

title: Autocad Draughtsman / Site Engineer - ( Mechanical )
description:
For Job Description : Draughtsman 
 The AutoCAD Draughtsman will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, and maintaining technical drawings and layouts for CBG projects. This includes civil, mechanical, piping, electrical, and structural works related to biogas digesters, purification systems, gas storage, and compression units. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 1. Drafting & Design Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models of CBG plant equipment and layouts using AutoCAD (and other relevant software).
 Develop general arrangement drawings (GADs) , fabrication drawings , and as-built drawings for civil foundations, piping, storage balloons, compressors, and cascade systems.
 Ensure that drawings comply with industry codes, safety norms, and company design standards .
 2. Coordination with Engineering Teams Work closely with process engineers, mechanical engineers, civil engineers, and electrical teams to finalize drawings.
 Incorporate design changes, feedback, and revisions from project managers and consultants.
 Support preparation of BOQs (Bill of Quantities) and assist procurement teams with technical specifications. 
 3. Documentation & Compliance Maintain proper records of drawings (revision control, issue logs).
 Ensure all drawings are aligned with CPCB, PESO, PNGRB, and local authority compliance requirements .
 Prepare drawings required for statutory approvals such as Pollution Control Certificates, PESO licensing, and safety audits.
 4. Site & Project Support Provide drawing support during construction, fabrication, and erection of CBG plants.
 Assist project/site engineers by preparing detailed shop drawings for contractors.
 Update as-built drawings after project completion. 
 5. Quality & Accuracy Check dimensions, tolerances, and alignment to ensure technical accuracy.
 Maintain drawing clarity for ease of execution at site.
 Ensure compatibility between civil, mechanical, and electrical layouts to avoid site clashes.
 Skill Requirements 
 Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D/3D) ; knowledge of SolidWorks/Revit will be an advantage.
 Understanding of piping design, civil foundations, storage tanks/balloons, and compressor systems used in CBG projects.
 Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, P&IDs, and equipment drawings .
 Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and timely delivery of drawings.
 Knowledge of safety standards and compliance for renewable energy plants preferred.

Coordinate with vendors during installation and commissioning.

Basic Knowledge of pumps, compressors, valves, gas storage, H2S scrubber, PSA, and pipelines preferred. Ability to read AutoCAD drawings and P&IDs . title: Project Engineering Director HVDC
description:
Job Description Summary The Project Engineering Director HVDC serves as the primary technical authority and engineering lead for large-scale HVDC projects. You will be responsible for the end-to-end technical delivery of HVDC systems, ensuring that engineering, design, testing, and commissioning activities are executed to the highest standards of safety, quality, and technical integrity.
You will manage a multidisciplinary engineering team and interface with internal manufacturing, sourcing, and project management teams, as well as external consortium partners and utility customers. This role is pivotal in ensuring that complex, multi-year energy transition projects meet all grid code requirements and performance specifications within budget and schedule. Job Description Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Project Leadership Lead the total engineering scope for HVDC projects, from contract inception through to final commissioning and site acceptance tests (SAT). Define the technical execution strategy, including design lifecycle, design reviews, and engineering document management. Act as the primary technical interface for the customer, acting as the bridge between internal engineering teams and customer technical stakeholders. Ensure technical alignment with consortium partners, subcontractors, and suppliers. 2. Engineering Governance and Quality Oversee the implementation of robust engineering processes, design verification, and validation (VV) procedures. Ensure all technical documentation meets company standards, international codes (IEC, IEEE), and grid code compliance. Lead formal design review processes (PDR, CDR) to ensure technical risk is identified and mitigated early. Manage engineering changes, deviations, and non-conformances with a focus on impact analysis and rigorous documentation. 3. Cross-Functional Integration Manage the interface between primary equipment, secondary systems, control, and protection, and HVDC valve/converter technology. Coordinate with Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to ensure technical specifications are met and supply chain risks are managed through engineering solutions. Drive the integration of digital tools and BIM/PLM processes to optimize engineering efficiency. Work closely with the Project Director to ensure engineering milestones support the overall project schedule and cash flow. 4. Technical Risk and Issue Management Proactively identify technical bottlenecks and system integration risks. title: Assistant Welfare Manager (Immediate Joiner, Garment Manufacturing)
description:
Position: Assistant Manager, Welfare
 Industry: Garment Manufacturing
 Department: HR / Welfare
 Gender: Female
 Location: Bengaluru
 Reporting To: HR Manager / Factory Head 
 1. Job Purpose To manage and strengthen employee welfare activities at the garment manufacturing facility, ensuring a safe, supportive, compliant, and employee-friendly workplace, with particular focus on the needs of women employees. The role will be responsible for employee welfare facilities, grievance handling, statutory welfare requirements, employee engagement, counselling/support, and coordination with internal departments and external agencies. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Absenteeism, Attrition & Employee Retention Management Monitor and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly absenteeism and attrition trends. Identify root causes of absenteeism and employee turnover through employee interactions, feedback, stay interviews and exit interviews. Track department-wise, line-wise, shift-wise and tenure-wise absenteeism and attrition. Identify high-risk employees and groups and take proactive retention measures. Follow up with frequent/long-absent employees and understand their concerns to support their return to work. Conduct regular employee connect sessions to identify and resolve workplace and welfare-related concerns. Develop and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives, particularly for women employees. Coordinate with HR, Production, and supervisors to address issues related to work environment, supervisors, transport, canteen, accommodation, working hours, and other welfare concerns. Monitor early attrition, particularly employee exits within the first 30/60/90 days, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare regular absenteeism, attrition, and retention MIS reports and present key findings and action plans to management. Measure the effectiveness of retention initiatives and continuously recommend improvements to reduce absenteeism and attrition. 
 B. Employee Welfare & Facilities Manage day-to-day employee welfare activities within the factory. Ensure availability and proper maintenance of welfare facilities such as: Canteen Drinking water Rest areas Washrooms Changing rooms First-aid facilities Transport facilities Childcare/crche facilities, where applicable Conduct regular welfare-facility inspections and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure welfare facilities are clean, hygienic, safe and accessible to employees. 
 C. Women Employee Welfare Act as a key point of contact for women employees regarding welfare-related concerns. Handle women employees' grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality. Support awareness initiatives related to workplace safety, dignity and respectful behaviour. Coordinate with relevant committees and management on matters concerning women employees. Support implementation and awareness of the organisation's POSH policy and related processes. Monitor issues affecting women employees and escalate serious concerns to HR management. 
 D. Employee Grievance Handling Receive, understand, and document employee grievances. Conduct employee interaction sessions and floor-level feedback activities. Coordinate with HR, Production, Compliance, and other departments to resolve grievances. Maintain proper records of grievances and closure status. Identify recurring employee issues and recommend preventive actions. 
 E. Statutory & Social Compliance Support HR/Compliance teams in meeting applicable labour and welfare requirements. Maintain welfare-related records and documentation required for audits and inspections. Coordinate preparation for customer/social-compliance audits. Ensure welfare practices are implemented in line with company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Support inspections by government authorities and other external agencies when required. 
 F. Employee Engagement Plan and coordinate employee engagement and welfare activities. Organise events and programmes such as:
 Employee awareness programmes Health and wellness activities Women's Day programmes Sports and cultural activities Employee recognition programmes Festival celebrations Counselling / awareness sessions Promote positive employee relations and improve employee participation. 
 G. Communication & Awareness Conduct regular employee awareness sessions on welfare-related topics. Communicate HR and welfare initiatives effectively to employees. Coordinate toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and employee meetings. Ensure employees understand available welfare facilities and support systems. 
 H. Employee Support & Counselling Maintain regular interaction with employees at the shop-floor level. Identify employee concerns relating to work environment, accommodation, transport, canteen, health, safety or personal difficulties. Provide basic counselling/support within the scope of the role and escalate sensitive or serious matters appropriately. Maintain confidentiality of employee information. 
 I. Reporting & Documentation Prepare periodic welfare reports for management. Track welfare complaints, actions and closure. Maintain records of welfare activities, inspections, meetings and employee engagement programmes. Analyse employee feedback and recommend improvements. Provide MIS reports to the HR Manager / Factory Head as required. 
 3. Key Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good employee-handling and grievance-management skills. Empathy and patience when dealing with employees. Strong understanding of workplace welfare practices. Ability to communicate effectively with women employees and shop-floor workers. Good coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good documentation and reporting skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams. Basic knowledge of MS Office / Excel / HR systems. 
 4. Qualification Master's degree in HR, Social Work, Labour Welfare, MBA or related discipline. 
 5. Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in employee welfare / HR/labour welfare, preferably in the garment, textile, manufacturing or factory environment . Experience handling a predominantly female workforce will be an advantage. Experience in social-compliance audits and employee grievance handling is preferred. 
 6. Preferred Knowledge Employee welfare practices Labour welfare requirements Grievance handling Women employee welfare POSH awareness and process coordination Social compliance requirements Factory welfare facilities Employee engagement Basic HR documentation and MIS Audit preparation and documentation 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely closure of employee grievances. Employee satisfaction with welfare facilities. Welfare facility inspection and corrective-action closure. Employee engagement and participation levels. Compliance with welfare-related requirements. Audit observations and timely closure. Effectiveness of employee communication and awareness programmes. Reduction in recurring employee welfare complaints. 
 8. Personal Attributes The candidate should be: Mature and responsible Approachable and empathetic Trustworthy and confidential Assertive when required Patient and calm under pressure Proactive in identifying employee issues Comfortable interacting with shop-floor employees Capable of handling sensitive employee matters professionally 
 Note: The position involves regular interaction with employees and may require frequent movement across the factory floor and welfare facilities.

title: Assistant HR - Administration Manager
description:
Roles and Responsibilities : Assistant Manager – Administration
Location: Chakan, Pune Function: Plant Administration / Facilities Reporting To: Plant HR Head / Factory HR Head  Workforce Environment: Approximately 1,500 employees per day, predominantly contractual blue-collar workforce
1. Job Purpose
The Assistant Manager – Administration will be responsible for the end-to-end administration and facility management of the Chakan manufacturing facility, ensuring a safe, secure, clean, hygienic, efficient and employee-friendly workplace.
The role will oversee critical plant administration services including security, employee transportation, canteen operations, housekeeping, facility upkeep, vendor management and large-scale employee events.
The position requires a highly hands-on individual who is comfortable operating on the shop floor, conducting regular facility rounds, managing large teams of outsourced personnel, monitoring service quality, identifying operational abnormalities and driving corrective actions.
The individual will be expected to build robust SOPs, checklists, audit mechanisms and governance systems for all major administrative services and continuously identify opportunities for manpower optimisation, cost reduction, service improvement and risk mitigation.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Security Management
Manage the complete security function of the manufacturing facility, including approximately 30–35 security personnel per shift.
Responsibilities
•
Manage day-to-day security operations across the plant, including access control, gate management, visitor management, material movement, employee entry/exit, vehicle movement and perimeter security.
•
Plan and optimise security manpower deployment across shifts, gates, critical areas and vulnerable locations.
•
Ensure appropriate deployment of security personnel based on operational risk rather than simply maintaining a fixed guard-to-area ratio.
•
Develop and implement comprehensive Security SOPs, post orders, checklists and escalation protocols.
•
Ensure security guards understand and comply with their respective post responsibilities.
•
Monitor compliance of the security agency with applicable requirements, including the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act (PSARA) and applicable requirements relating to security guards and agencies.
•
Ensure appropriate documentation, verification, training and deployment of security personnel through the security vendor.
•
Establish systems for CCTV monitoring and surveillance across critical areas of the facility.
•
Review CCTV footage, security registers and incident records to identify:
o
Abnormal movements
o
Unauthorised access
o
Repeated security violations
o
Material movement irregularities
o
Gate-control weaknesses
o
Unsafe behaviour
o
Other security abnormalities
•
Use CCTV observations and security data to optimise security manpower and deployment patterns.
•
Establish an incident-reporting and escalation mechanism for security incidents.
•
Conduct periodic security audits and vulnerability assessments.
•
Coordinate with local authorities/police wherever required in connection with security incidents.
•
Ensure adequate emergency response mechanisms for incidents such as theft, trespassing, violence, fire, accidents or other security emergencies.
Expected capability
A strong candidate should be able to demonstrate that they have personally managed security operations, rather than simply coordinating with a security agency. They should be capable of walking through the plant, identifying security vulnerabilities and redesigning guard deployment based on actual risk and CCTV/security intelligence.
3. Employee Transportation Management
Manage the complete employee transportation operation comprising approximately 15–18 buses, including transportation of women employees during night shifts.
Responsibilities
•
Plan and manage employee transportation based on shift timings, employee residential locations, workforce strength and daily attendance patterns.
•
Develop dynamic/adaptive transportation plans based on actual workforce requirements.
•
Optimise bus utilisation by matching vehicle capacity to actual passenger demand.
•
Develop mechanisms whereby vehicle size/capacity can be adjusted based on population—for example, deploying smaller vehicles where a particular route has lower utilisation.
•
Monitor:
o
Route-wise utilisation
o
Seat utilisation
o
Trip frequency
o
Empty-seat percentage
o
Cost per employee/trip
o
Route adherence
o
Delays
o
Missed pickups
o
Breakdown incidents
•
Coordinate with transport vendors to optimise routes and fleet deployment.
•
Ensure compliance with applicable RTO/transport regulations and other statutory requirements relating to employee transportation.
•
Ensure vehicles deployed meet applicable fitness, permit, insurance, safety and documentation requirements.
•
Establish SOPs covering:
o
Bus inspection
o
Driver verification
o
Vehicle fitness checks
o
Pre-trip/post-trip checks
o
Route adherence
o
Emergency response
o
Breakdown management
o
Accident reporting
o
Passenger safety
o
Night-shift transportation
•
Establish appropriate mechanisms for monitoring and responding to transport incidents and accidents.
•
Build an effective transport intelligence mechanism through drivers, transport supervisors, employees, security and other stakeholders to identify incidents, unsafe behaviour or route-related concerns proactively.
•
Establish and lead a Transport Committee comprising relevant factory stakeholders.
•
Conduct periodic reviews of vehicle condition, driver behaviour, route safety and employee feedback.
•
Ensure special attention to the safety and security of women employees travelling during night shifts.
•
Drive corrective actions for recurring transport-related complaints or incidents.
Expected capability
A strong candidate should be able to explain how they would take a fixed fleet and continuously optimise it based on changing employee populations, rather than simply allocating one bus to one route.
They should understand that transport management is simultaneously a cost, safety, employee-experience and compliance responsibility.
4. Employee Canteen Management
Manage the employee canteen operation serving approximately 500 employees per shift.
Responsibilities
•
Manage the overall functioning of the employee canteen and ensure consistent availability of safe, hygienic and good-quality food.
•
Manage the canteen vendor and ensure adherence to agreed service levels, menu, quality and hygiene standards.
•
Ensure compliance with applicable food safety, hygiene and canteen-related statutory requirements.
•
Develop and implement SOPs and checklists covering:
o
Food preparation
o
Raw-material receipt
o
Storage
o
Cooking
o
Food temperature
o
Food handling
o
Personal hygiene
o
Cleaning and sanitation
o
Pest control
o
Drinking water
o
Waste disposal
o
Utensil cleaning
o
Food sampling/retention, where applicable
•
Conduct regular physical inspections of the canteen and food preparation areas.
•
Conduct periodic audits of the canteen vendor against defined hygiene and service standards.
•
Establish mechanisms for recording and resolving employee feedback and complaints relating to food quality, hygiene, quantity and service.
•
Form and coordinate a Canteen Committee involving relevant factory stakeholders and employee representatives, where appropriate.
•
Conduct periodic canteen committee reviews and drive closure of identified actions.
•
Monitor canteen consumption and utilisation patterns.
•
Understand the roles, responsibilities and productivity of each category of canteen vendor manpower.
•
Assess opportunities for manpower optimisation without compromising food quality, hygiene or service levels.
•
Monitor food cost, wastage and consumption patterns and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
•
Ensure effective management of food-related incidents and escalation protocols.
Expected capability
The candidate should be able to walk into a canteen and independently identify hygiene, food safety, manpower, productivity and process gaps, rather than relying entirely on the vendor's supervisor.
5. Housekeeping & Facility Upkeep
Manage housekeeping and general facility upkeep across the manufacturing facility.
Responsibilities
•
Ensure high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and upkeep across:
o
Washrooms
o
Common areas
o
Employee areas
o
Canteen surroundings
o
Offices
o
Corridors
o
Staircases
o
Parking areas
o
Other common facility areas
•
Plan housekeeping manpower deployment based on area, footfall, shift and cleaning frequency requirements.
•
Establish defined cleaning standards and service-level expectations for each area.
•
Develop SOPs, cleaning schedules and checklists for housekeeping activities.
•
Conduct regular physical rounds of the facility and personally inspect cleanliness standards.
•
Ensure washrooms are adequately stocked, clean, functional and hygienic throughout operating hours.
•
Monitor housekeeping attendance and actual manpower deployment.
•
Identify under-utilised or overlapping housekeeping roles and develop manpower optimisation proposals.
•
Monitor quality and productivity of housekeeping personnel.
•
Establish mechanisms for immediate escalation and closure of hygiene-related complaints.
•
Coordinate with maintenance teams for issues relating to plumbing, electrical fixtures, water supply, drainage and other facility-related problems.
•
Monitor pest-control activities and hygiene-related preventive measures.
•
Conduct periodic facility audits and maintain action trackers.
Expected capability
The candidate should be physically present on the floor and conduct regular rounds, rather than managing the facility primarily through MIS or vendor calls.
A good candidate should be able to identify within a few rounds:
“We have X people deployed here, this activity actually requires Y, this area is not being cleaned at the required frequency, and this is the corrective action.”
6. Vendor Management & Cost Optimisation
Manage administrative service providers and ensure high-quality service delivery at optimal cost.
Responsibilities
•
Manage relationships with security, transport, housekeeping, canteen and other facility-management vendors.
•
Establish clear scope of work, SLAs, KPIs and performance standards for each vendor.
•
Conduct regular vendor performance reviews.
•
Monitor contractual manpower deployment versus approved manpower.
•
Validate vendor bills against actual service delivery and manpower deployment.
•
Identify discrepancies, over-deployment and billing irregularities.
•
Negotiate commercial terms, rates and service conditions with vendors within organisational guidelines.
•
Identify opportunities for cost reduction through manpower optimisation, process redesign, route optimisation, vendor consolidation and improved utilisation.
•
Develop and maintain a strong network of local service providers to support quick sourcing of alternate vendors.
•
Identify, evaluate and onboard new vendors where required.
•
Conduct vendor benchmarking and periodically assess whether existing vendors remain commercially and operationally competitive.
•
Maintain appropriate vendor documentation and performance records.
•
Work with Procurement/Commercial teams wherever formal sourcing or contracting processes are applicable.
•
Ensure vendor relationships are managed professionally while maintaining appropriate governance and commercial discipline.
Expected capability
The candidate should demonstrate commercial acumen, not merely vendor coordination. They should be able to give examples of actual cost savings, manpower optimisation, renegotiation or service improvements achieved.
7. Employee Events & Engagement Support
Plan and execute large-scale employee events at the manufacturing facility.
Responsibilities
•
Plan and execute events involving 1,000+ employees, including:
o
Town halls
o
Festival celebrations
o
Ganesh Chaturthi
o
Diwali
o
Employee engagement programmes
o
Recognition events
o
Plant celebrations
•
Develop event plans covering venue, crowd management, security, food, transportation, housekeeping, stage/setup, vendor coordination and emergency preparedness.
•
Coordinate with HR, Plant leadership, Security, Production and other stakeholders.
•
Ensure events are planned without adversely affecting production operations.
•
Manage external event-management vendors and service providers.
•
Prepare event budgets and monitor expenditure.
•
Ensure appropriate crowd-control and emergency-response arrangements.
•
Conduct post-event reviews and identify improvements for future events.
8. Administration SOPs, Audits & Governance
•
Develop and maintain SOPs for all major administration processes.
•
Establish checklists and audit mechanisms for:
o
Security
o
CCTV monitoring
o
Employee transport
o
Canteen
o
Housekeeping
o
Facility upkeep
o
Emergency response
o
Vendor management
•
Establish daily/weekly/monthly administration review mechanisms.
•
Maintain appropriate MIS and dashboards for key administration metrics.
•
Conduct periodic audits and ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
•
Maintain documentation required for internal and external audits.
•
Continuously review processes and identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and simplification.
9. Safety, Risk & Incident Management
•
Identify administrative and facility-related risks across the plant.
•
Establish appropriate preventive and corrective measures.
•
Ensure emergency response mechanisms are established for security, transport, food safety and facility incidents.
•
Investigate administration-related incidents and conduct RCA.
•
Track corrective actions to closure.
•
Coordinate with EHS/Safety teams on matters having overlapping safety implications.
•
Ensure administration vendors and their employees comply with applicable plant safety requirements.
•
Escalate high-risk issues immediately to the relevant plant leadership.

title: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device
description:
Job Description: QA Engineer Wireless RAN & Device (LTE/5G/ Wi-Fi) 
 Role Overview 
 The QA Engineer – Wireless RAN & Device Validation is responsible for end-to-end validation of LTE and 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions, ensuring feature compliance, RF performance, interoperability, and customer experience across commercial network deployments. The role involves validation of eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN platforms, radio features, RF performance, and protocol compliance, while also supporting validation of LTE/5G devices including smartphones and FWA CPEs to ensure seamless end-to-end interoperability between network and devices. The engineer will work closely with RAN & Device Engineering, Product, Network Operations, OEMs, and chipset vendors throughout the product lifecycle. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Define test strategy, test plans, test cases, and RTM for LTE/5G/WiFi RAN products and wireless solutions. Perform end-to-end validation of LTE/LTE-A/5G NR features, covering functional, protocol, RF, interoperability, performance, regression, and customer experience testing Validate Macro Cells, Small Cells, vRAN/ORAN, and eNB/gNB deployments in both lab and field environments Execute RF validation for TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, Beamforming, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and Throughput Conduct acceptance testing, benchmarking, and standards compliance validation against 3GPP and O-RAN specifications Analyze Layer 1–3 logs and troubleshoot air interface, S1/X2/Xn, IMS, and interoperability issues through Root Cause Analysis Develop and maintain OTA and conducted test lines in Lab for end-to-end RAN, Core, and Device validation Validate LTE/5G commercial devices (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, and data devices) to ensure network interoperability and customer experience Collaborate with RAN strategy/ planning, Device Engineering, Network teams, OEMs, and chipset vendors for issue resolution and product quality improvements Drive test automation, manage the defect lifecycle, prepare technical documentation, and provide Go/No-Go recommendations for commercial releases. 
 Required Skills & Technical Expertise 
 Strong knowledge of LTE/LTE-A, 5G NR (NSA/SA),Wi-Fi(802.11ac/ax/be), vRAN, ORAN, IMS, RAN architecture, and 3GPP/O-RAN standards Good understanding of RF technologies including TDD/FDD, OFDMA, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, Carrier Aggregation, Mobility, Handover, QoS, and throughput optimization Hands-on experience in RAN feature, protocol, performance, KPI, capacity, stability, and interoperability testing Proficiency in RF and wireless test tools such as TM500, Keysight, Anritsu, QXDM, TEMS, XCAL, Wireshark, iPerf, and IxLoad Strong expertise in Layer 1–3 log analysis, protocol debugging (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS), and end-to-end call flow analysis Exposure to LTE/5G device validation (Smartphones, FWA CPEs, MiFi) with ADB and chipset debugging tools (Qualcomm/MediaTek/UNISOC) is an added advantage Knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages for test automation is desirable Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 8–12 years of experience in LTE/5G RAN Testing, RF Validation, or Telecom Product QA. Hands-on experience in eNodeB/gNodeB, vRAN/ORAN, RAN feature validation, RF performance, protocol analysis, and interoperability testing. Experience in commercial acceptance testing and field validation of LTE/5G radio products. Exposure to LTE/5G device validation and end-to-end network-device integration will be an added advantage. Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related Engineering discipline.

Key Skills: 802.11,Wireshark,IxLoad,Anritsu,TEMS,Telecom,Keysight,ORAN
